verdict.rationale: Shopify storefronts expose a per-merchant /api/ucp/mcp endpoint and a /.well-known/ucp business profile, and a live probe confirmed one on a Shopify-operated store. Marketing says merchants get AI-channel discovery without lifting a finger, implying automatic enablement. However, the docs are written for agent developers and never document a merchant-side opt-in setting, agreement, or how a store becomes 'UCP-enabled'. missing for 10: documented merchant enablement steps (setting/toggle or agreement), merchant-facing docs on publishing or controlling the UCP endpoint and profile, independent merchant-side corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint

citations.quote: Get discovered across AI channels. Shoppers check out right in the chat. You don’t lift a finger.
the business side publishes its own at the storefront origin ({shop}.myshopify.com/.well-known/ucp)
the per-merchant /api/ucp/mcp surface every UCP-enabled storefront exposes to agents
